title: Netspective Foundation, Inc.
summary: A nonprofit operating company that equips medical researchers, clinicians, and patient advocates with software engineering, data architecture, AI, and machine learning to advance real-world evidence.
detail: Netspective Foundation stands at the intersection of technology and medical research. It builds custom data-collection tools, data-management platforms, and AI-driven models for patient registries and research groups, with a focus on high-prevalence chronic conditions.

Its Research as a Service model democratizes access to analytics and cloud-based collaboration environments, making biomedical discovery more accessible for professional researchers and citizen scientists alike. The output is public research capability, not an owned position.

We list it in the portfolio because it is an operating entity we started and continue to support, and because its work on real-world data and evidence feeds the same kinds of questions our Care Delivery funds and IP programs ask.
